name: İzmir · Konak Tramvayı (Halkapınar — Fahrettin Altay)
description: Real-world alignment of İzmir's T2/Konak tram line: 19 stops (Halkapınar to Fahrettin Altay) along the real official stop coordinates published by the İzmir metropolitan municipality open-data portal, with a depot at the Halkapınar terminus and traffic signals at three well-known major crossings along the corridor (Gazi Bulvarı, Konak Meydanı, Üçkuyular).
useCase: A real single-line urban tram corridor (as opposed to the Nizhny Novgorod scenario's shared two-route ring), for studying headway management, signal priority and depot operations on a linear line with a single terminal depot.
